en.headline: Hong Kong signs 60th tax pact, this time with Slovenia
en.dek: The comprehensive double-tax agreement is the fifth concluded this year; it still needs ratification before the new withholding rates take effect.
body: The Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Christopher Hui, signed a comprehensive avoidance of double taxation agreement with Slovenia in Hong Kong on Friday. He signed for the Hong Kong government; Slovenia was represented by its ambassador to China, Boštjan Malovrh.

Hui said the pact was Hong Kong’s 60th comprehensive double-tax agreement, the 15th signed by the current-term government and the fifth this year. He described Slovenia as an important European trading partner and a participant in the Belt and Road Initiative, and said the agreement would allocate taxing rights so investors could better assess cross-border liabilities and avoid being taxed twice on the same income.

Under the agreement, tax paid by Hong Kong residents in Slovenia may be credited against Hong Kong tax on the same income, subject to the Inland Revenue Ordinance. Slovenia’s withholding tax on dividends paid to Hong Kong residents, now as high as 25 per cent, will be capped at 10 per cent; withholding tax on interest and royalties, also now as high as 25 per cent, will be reduced to 5 per cent.

The agreement will take effect after both sides complete ratification. In Hong Kong, the Chief Executive in Council will make an order under the Inland Revenue Ordinance for negative vetting by the Legislative Council. Hui said talks with Kazakhstan had been completed and that negotiations with Uzbekistan were expected to start later this year.

zh.headline: 香港與斯洛文尼亞簽署第60份全面性稅務協定
zh.dek: 這是本屆政府第15份、今年第五份全面性避免雙重課稅協定，須待雙方完成批准程序後生效。
body: 財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇星期五在香港與斯洛文尼亞共和國駐華大使馬博洋簽署全面性避免雙重課稅協定，分別代表特區政府及斯洛文尼亞政府。
許正宇表示，這是香港第60份全面性協定，亦是本屆政府第15份、今年第五份，標誌拓展協定網絡的工作進入新里程。他指斯洛文尼亞是香港在歐洲的重要貿易夥伴，亦是「一帶一路」參與者；協定謘明兩地徵稅權，讓投資者更有效評估跨境稅務負擔及避免雙重課稅。
按照協定，香港居民在斯洛文尼亞繳付的稅項，可根據《稅務條例》抵免香港就同一筆收入徵收的稅項。斯洛文尼亞向香港居民徵收的股息預扣稅，現時最高25%，將降至最高10%；利息及特許權使用費預扣稅現時最高亦為25%，將降至5%。
協定須待雙方完成批准程序後生效。香港方面，行政長官會同行政會議會根據《稅務條例》作出命令，以先訂立後審議程序提交立法會。許正宇表示，與哈薩克的協定磬商已經完成，今年內亦將與烏茲別克展開磬商。
